notes: New venue coverage for Warren County NJ comes mostly from the Explore Warren tourism calendar (explorewarren.org). All 24 month views from Jan 2025 to Dec 2026 were crawled, and 562 music-related event pages were parsed; many venues post their monthly lineups there. Czig Meister and Funk/Illumination were read from their own Tribe events APIs, and Bonn Place from its public Google Calendar. Lehigh Valley bar coverage is thin. Lehighvalleylive and Bandsintown block bots, HiJinx returns 403, and Lost Tavern, Yergey and Man Skirt rate-limit (HTTP 429), so only their current pages were read. Easton Post's API keeps no past events, and the Wayback Machine was 'temporarily offline' today, so Jan 2025–Sep 2026 Lehigh bar dates could not be backfilled. Two Rivers Brewing closed in Aug 2025. One Centre Square's website is down. Pearly Baker's, Molly's, Archie's, the Fairgrounds Hotel, Sette Luna and Mesa (Easton) could not be confirmed as 2025–26 band venues. Nazareth, Bath, Catasauqua, Coopersburg and Whitehall turned up no findable 2025–26 band listings. Solo artists, DJs, open mics and school/community ensembles were excluded. For the re-pulled ArtsQuest, Musikfest and Godfrey Daniels data (from the earlier crawl's master.json, now with single appearances), solo acts were removed with a first-name heuristic plus a manual exclusion list, so a few solo acts or missed bands may remain. Dates after 2026-10-26 are scheduled, not yet played. William's Irish Tavern (Johnny Charles & His Band, 2026-09-25) was left out because its town could not be confirmed.
